description: Search the text of the user's imported LinkedIn messages (DMs), newest first. Filter by words in the message, by the person it was with, and by date. Use for 'who messaged me about hiring?', 'find the LinkedIn message where someone mentioned Shopify', 'what LinkedIn messages did I get last month?'. Returns snippets; read a whole thread with get_linkedin_conversation.

limit.description: How many messages to return (default 20, max 50).

person.description: Only messages sent by or to this person (name, partial names match).

query.description: Words or a phrase to find in the message text or subject.

since.description: Only messages on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Only messages before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_linkedin_messages
title: Search LinkedIn messages
